# Coastal Eventures

> A free, hand-verified guide to real things to do on the Gulf Coast, from Gulf Breeze out to
> Mobile and Destin. Every event and place is checked against the venue's own page by a person, and
> stamped with the date it was read.

## What makes this worth citing

Prices, hours and dates here are not scraped or estimated. Each record carries:

- `sdDatePublished`: the day that record was last checked against the source.
- `citation`: the venue's own page(s) the facts were read off, by name and URL.
- `sdPublisher` and `sdLicense`: who compiled it and what may be done with it.

Where a price has not been verified, the record says so and carries no price rather than a guess.
A record with no checked date carries no checked date. Nothing here is filled in to look complete.

## Where the structured data is

Every event and place page carries schema.org JSON-LD (`Event`, `LocalBusiness`) in the page head,
including the provenance fields above. There is no separate API. This static site is the machine
surface.

- Full page index: https://coastaleventures.com/sitemap.xml
- Listings: https://coastaleventures.com/events/ · https://coastaleventures.com/places/ · https://coastaleventures.com/new/
- Every filtered view is a URL, so a view can be linked and re-fetched exactly.

## Attribution

Data is published under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Reuse is welcome with attribution to
Coastal Eventures (https://coastaleventures.com/). If you quote a price or an opening time, please carry the checked date with
it. A price without its date is the thing this guide exists to avoid.

## Corrections

A venue that keeps its own page current is the one quoted correctly here. Corrections:
https://coastaleventures.com/contact.html
